NIELIT CCC Online Form, Admit Card, Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT) conducts the Course on Computer Concepts (CCC) Examination 2026 every month, for which the CCC Online Form, Admit Card, and Result are released from time to time. NIELIT CCC Online Registration Form 2026 has started Till the Date 30 September 2026. Candidates who wish to apply for NIELIT CCC Admission 2026 are advised to read the complete notification carefully before applying and check all important details such as Eligibility, Application Fee, Age Limit, Exam Pattern, and other requirements. All important information related to the NIELIT CCC Online Form 2026, Notification, Admit Card, Result, and Apply Online Link is provided below.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
